The centering gamma-log(2), variance (log 2)^2+Li_2(1/4), higher cumulants and positive third cumulant follow algebraically. Projection of an (m+1)-Gaussian to 1-perp has chi_m radial factor independent of direction, and its O_P(m^{-1/2}) relative fluctuation is negligible at b_m squared scale. The exact expectation uses independence of radial and angular factors and E Gaussian range 2 mu_k. Finite examples only verify finite identities, not convergence.
